worldcombat.skill.stomp.summary: A whole-body downward slam: the heaviest melee move in the family, with a chance to flinch and a ground shock that also staggers grounded foes around the landing - but it only lands on a grounded target, so anything airborne dodges it.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.description.0: The stomp deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.description.1: The landing shakes a %1$s block radius for about %2$s to each other grounded foe; heavier bodies shake wider.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.description.2: A %1$s flinch chance for the main target and %2$s for those only caught by the shock, for %3$s s; an airborne target is missed.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.heavy.on: Heavy form: raises higher, slams harder, cracks and shakes wider and staggers more often, but winds up slower and has a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.heavy.off: Quick press: faster, smaller and slightly lighter.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the aftershock to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s, the shock radius to %3$s blocks and the main flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.use.0: Crush and flinch an approaching foe underfoot
worldcombat.skill.stomp.use.1: Catch other grounded foes around the landing with the shock
worldcombat.skill.stomp.use.2: Cash in the heaviest hit once a foe is forced to the ground
worldcombat.skill.stomp.preference.heavy: On: raises higher, slams harder, cracks and shakes wider and staggers more often, but winds up slower and has a longer cooldown. Off: a quick press - faster, smaller and slightly lighter.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Too large makes the companion travel far for a slow move and get kited during the wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.stomp.preference.ai.fi: On: prioritise the stomp when the target is below a third of its health. Off: sort it as an ordinary melee candidate.
